M01.note: no C-different pairs at this matching tier; no label distribution exists

B1.note: no C-different pairs at this matching tier; no label distribution exists

M01.definition: same B0 AND same B1(T1), different C  [strictest bag]
M01.note: Empirical in-sample lower bound: predict each bag by the median of its own y.  Singleton bags contribute 0 by construction, so the whole-train value is small whenever the bag is a near-identity; this is not a generalisation bound and not a BJOC-P3 error bound.

B1.definition: same B1(T1), different C  [local-patch bag only]
B1.note: Empirical in-sample lower bound: predict each bag by the median of its own y.  Singleton bags contribute 0 by construction, so the whole-train value is small whenever the bag is a near-identity; this is not a generalisation bound and not a BJOC-P3 error bound.

M0.definition: same B0, different C  [strict marginal control; B1 may differ]
M0.note: Empirical in-sample lower bound: predict each bag by the median of its own y.  Singleton bags contribute 0 by construction, so the whole-train value is small whenever the bag is a near-identity; this is not a generalisation bound and not a BJOC-P3 error bound.

L_old.definition: same (n_bonds, bond-class counts, line-graph-degree distribution, junction-count distribution), different C [the historical bond-RW coarse marginal signature; NOT composition-controlled]
L_old.note: Empirical in-sample lower bound: predict each bag by the median of its own y.  Singleton bags contribute 0 by construction, so the whole-train value is small whenever the bag is a near-identity; this is not a generalisation bound and not a BJOC-P3 error bound.

stage_c_gate.reason: No strict same-B0+same-B1 different-C bags exist, so G1/G2 fail.  B1 is injective on distinct constitutions (B1 different-C groups = 0), so a Control that uses B1 already contains C implicitly; a Control restricted to B0 would reintroduce the very marginal confounds this audit controls.  No fair Control/Real/Null probe can be constructed, hence G3 fails.
stage_c_gate.note: This is a screening gate, not a test of non-GNN composition mechanisms in general.  No training was run and no GPU was used.
